Файлы, которые вы уже удалили. После очи: Files you have already deleted. They cannot be restored after cleaning.
Проверьте, что в корзине нет нужного — в: Check that nothing you need is in the Recycle Bin — it cannot be restored.
Копии обновлений Windows, которые раздаю: Copies of Windows updates shared with other computers. Windows cleans it itself, but not always in time.
Снимки системы для отката. Нужны, если п: System snapshots for rollback. Needed if something breaks after an update or driver.
Удалить старые: «Защита системы» → «Наст: Delete old ones: “System Protection” → “Configure” → “Delete” (the latest point is deleted too).
Точки занимают больше 15 ГБ. Если систем: The points take more than 15 GB. If the system is stable, old ones can be deleted and the limit under “Configure” reduced to 5–10 %.
Папка TEMP вашего профиля: остатки устан: Your profile’s TEMP folder: leftovers of installers and programs. Only files older than two days are deleted.
Системная папка Windows\\Temp. Только фа: The system Windows\Temp folder. Only files older than two days.
Установочные файлы уже установленных обн: Installation files of updates that are already installed (older than 10 days). Windows downloads them again if needed.
Отчёты Windows о сбоях программ, которые: Windows reports about program crashes that were already sent or are not needed.
HTML-отчёты и журналы Opti старше 30 дне: Opti HTML reports and logs older than 30 days (the rollback journal is not touched).
Картинки-превью в Проводнике. Будут созд: Preview images in Explorer. They are re-created when folders are opened.
Скомпилированные шейдеры игр. Помогает,: Compiled game shaders. Helps if games started to stutter after a driver update.
Первый запуск каждой игры после очистки: The first launch of each game after cleaning will stutter until the cache fills up again.
Только кеш Chrome, Edge, Brave, Яндекс,: Only the cache of Chrome, Edge, Brave, Yandex, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox: passwords, history, tabs and extensions are not affected.
Закройте браузеры перед очисткой — откры: Close browsers before cleaning — open files are skipped. Websites will load slightly slower the first time.
Файлы, которые Windows и программы созда: Files Windows and programs create on crashes and blue screens.
Нужны для диагностики синих экранов. Уда: Needed to diagnose blue screens. Delete only if the crashes are gone.
Папки C:\\NVIDIA и C:\\AMD: туда драйвер: The C:\NVIDIA and C:\AMD folders: drivers are extracted there before installing and stay forever.
Старые журналы установки обновлений и ко: Old update and component installation logs (CBS, DISM) older than 30 days.
Кеш Discord, Steam, Epic, Spotify, Teams: Discord, Steam, Epic, Spotify, Teams cache
Временный кеш интерфейса программ: карти: Temporary interface cache of these programs: images, web pages, video. Accounts, chats and games are not affected.
Закройте эти программы перед очисткой —: Close these programs before cleaning — open files are skipped.
Установщики, архивы и файлы, скачанные и: Installers, archives and files downloaded from the internet. Opti does not clean it — sort it out manually, sorting by size.
«Загрузки» весят больше 5 ГБ. Обычно там: Downloads is larger than 5 GB. It usually holds old installers and archives — delete them and move what you need to Documents.
Записи игр (OBS, NVIDIA, Xbox Game Bar): Game recordings (OBS, NVIDIA, Xbox Game Bar) and movies in Videos, Downloads and on the desktop. The largest are listed below; open and delete the ones you do not need.
Остаётся после обновления или переустано: Left after an upgrade or a reinstall that kept files. Windows removes it itself: Settings → Storage → Temporary files.
